tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Fetch the transcript of a public YouTube video. Accepts a full URL or an 11-character video ID. Defaults to Markdown (title + text), which is the most compact format for reading or summarizing. Use json for timestamped segments, srt/vtt for subtitle files. Costs 1 credit on success.

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: List the caption tracks available for a YouTube video. Free, and does not use credits.

tools.name: list_playlist_videos
tools.description: List the videos in a YouTube playlist, or a channel's uploads (newest first), with titles and durations. Accepts playlist links or IDs and channel links or @handles. Free. Use get_transcript on the videos you need.

tools.name: search_youtube
tools.description: Search YouTube for videos, or search within one channel by passing its link or @handle. Returns video IDs, titles, channels, durations, and view counts. Free. Use get_transcript on the videos you need.

tools.name: summarize_video
tools.description: Summary, key points, and timestamped study notes for a public YouTube video, generated from its transcript. Written in the transcript's language (translate_to changes which transcript is summarized). Costs 1 credit for the transcript plus 1 for the summary (2 total).

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show the remaining TranscriptYT credits and plan for this API key. Free.
